newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe tourism set for further growth - Mugabe.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe tourism set for further growth - Mugabe.

text.p: Zimbabwean President Robert Mugabe said on Thursday the country's tourism industry would net in over Z$2 billion ($185.2 million) this year, a five percent increase over 1995.

Addressing parliament, Mugabe said the sector had grown at an average annual rate of 10 percent in terms of visitor arrivals since independence from Britain in 1980 and had become one of the mainstays of the southern African country's economy.
"The tourism industry is increasingly becoming important to the economy in terms of the creation and distribution of wealth," Mugabe said.
Tourism now employs over 100,000 Zimbabweans, up from 83,000 in 1995.
